acceptance.text: The responses usage parser tolerates OpenRouter's aggregator decorations - cost, cost_details, is_byok - instead of failing the turn INVALID_USAGE (the closed optional list at internal/driver/responses.go:298-301), and the cost decoration is captured as provider-reported cost in the usage vocabulary the 2026-08-23-telemetry-foundations S1 slice established, never discarded. Pinned by parser tests over recorded OpenRouter response fixtures. Evidence basis: certifying stealth/ox-alpha failed certification_usage_failed on exactly this until an operator binary patch (preserved at the release ops home as operator-engine-patches.diff).

The SSE reader handles data-only streams: when a provider emits no event: field lines (OpenRouter), the event name falls back to the payload's self-describing type field before the event is dropped (internal/driver/stream.go:255-270 - today the terminal event is never recognized and the whole stream dies PROVIDER_TRANSPORT_FAILED), while event:-labeled streams (deepseek, qwencloud) parse exactly as before. Pinned by fixture tests over both stream shapes, including a recorded OpenRouter stream whose terminal carries the full response object.

The chat-completions accept path admits the root-level provider decoration OpenRouter injects into every response (the closed root list at internal/driver/openai.go:470 - today any openrouter-chat response fails continuation.openai.accept_root_invalid, which means the recorded qwen/qwen3.8-max certification on that profile is stale and unreproducible). Pinned by a recorded chat fixture; the field is tolerated and ignored.

Decoration stays decoration: no tolerated field beyond the captured cost feeds accounting, validation, or continuation state - pinned by tests asserting identical turns with and without the decorations, differing only in the cost observation.

constraints: Evidence basis (2026-08-23, ox-alpha certification session): three tolerance gaps found in sequence - INVALID_USAGE on the cost decorations, PROVIDER_TRANSPORT_FAILED on data-only SSE, accept_root_invalid on the chat provider field. The first two ship today as uncommitted operator patches in the release ops binary; this slice is their honest landing with tests.
The strict-decoder posture survives: unknown fields outside the named decorations still fail closed. This slice names specific aggregator vocabulary; it does not open the decoders.
Check evidence belongs in the submission's checks field, never in files added to the repository.
